Sam — great questions, answered inline below and added a few concrete bullets to keep this moving.

1) Hosted vs Dedicated
- Hosted (fastest onboarding): multi-tenant with region controls; good for proofs-of-concept and early pilots. SLA available on paid tiers; predictable but not isolated hardware.
- Dedicated: single-tenant GPU pools you reserve; predictable throughput and stronger isolation (recommended for customer-facing low-latency production). On A100-class, p95 for short chat workloads typically <100ms with our optimizations.

2) Data residency
- Hosted: we can restrict processing to EU regions for EU customers; if you need the control plane to be customer-managed (VPC) or have strict contractual residency, Private is the path.

3) Ballpark pilot pricing (approx; final depends on model & quantization)
- Hosted pilot: ~$3k–$6k/month (managed, regional hosting)
- Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity): ~$9k–$18k/month (includes reserved GPU pool + network)

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf (same deck as earlier)
Security artifacts
- Connor will send SOC2 and our standard security questionnaire in a separate email today.

Next steps
- Connor — can you propose 2x slots for a technical deep-dive (Tue/Wed next week)?
- Sam/Jordan — if Q3 pilot still sounds right, we can draft a MAP and show a sample SOW for procurement.

If your priority has shifted, totally understand — a quick note back is helpful so we don’t keep pinging. Appreciate it.

Thanks,
